content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Online marketplace connecting hosts and guests, not an owner-operator of upscale hotels and resorts."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants, not hotel rooms, dining and meeting space."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Casino-led regional gaming resorts; gambling drives the business rather than upscale hotel operations."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Nevada casinos, locals gaming and tavern slot routes; gaming is the core, not upscale hotels."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells timeshare vacation ownership and finances purchases; does not own and operate hotel rooms for nightly guests."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Casino resorts in Reno and Black Hawk where gaming is the primary revenue, not upscale hotels."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"News publishing, data and property listing portals; no hotel or hospitality operations."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas locals casino resorts; gaming and local customers differ from upscale travel hotels."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Holding company with one San Francisco hotel, apartment rentals and securities; hotel is a minor part."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatre circuit is the larger business; hotels and resorts are one separate segment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Restaurant operator and brand licensor; dining is the product, not hotel rooms or meeting space."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Land development, residential lot sales and timber; hotels are a secondary part of the business."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Online travel review and advertising platform; does not own or operate hotels."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Ski mountain operator selling lift passes and seasonal resort access; winter sports, not upscale hotel operations."}]}
